source: APPP / MAFF-JICA — Rice Seed Production Manual (សៀវភៅមគ្គទេសក៍ផលិតកម្មពូជស្រូវ), 2014, Agricultural Productivity Promotion Project in West Tonle Sap, p.37
text: After drying, seed paddy is cleaned and packed for storage/distribution: (1) Re-check moisture content before bagging. (2) Winnow/clean the dried paddy using a winnowing machine or fan to remove chaff, empty grains, and husk fragments so only well-filled grain remains. (3) Weigh out and bag the cleaned seed at a standard 40 kg per sack. (4) Weigh each sack on a calibrated scale and seal/sew the bag closed. (5) Group members responsible for seed production must ensure every bag is properly and accurately labeled, since seed sold under this program is expected to meet a defined quality standard (see seed quality standards for distribution).
